product_one_liner.value: Funnel provides a marketing intelligence platform that collects, prepares, and centralizes marketing data and supports reporting and measurement for marketing and data teams.
product_one_liner.notes: The About page describes Funnel’s marketing data hub and its intended marketing and data team users.

pricing_page.notes: Funnel has a public pricing page, regardless of whether all plan prices are displayed.

named_customers.notes: Both customer names appear among Funnel’s case-study examples.

employee_band.notes: Funnel describes itself as having 300+ employees, which falls in the 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: Funnel identifies Stockholm as its headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The company states it was founded in 2014.

eng_blog.notes: The official development blog contains multiple technical posts about the platform and its engineering, including data ingestion, platform architecture, and connector development.

public_docs.notes: Funnel has a public Help Center with product articles and release notes.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Product Engineer - AI Product Experience posting qualifies as an AI-related role.

model_provider.notes: Checked Funnel’s product help documentation, AI-related public materials, security information, and available subprocessor information; no particular model or model provider is publicly identified.

compliance_certs.notes: The page states ISO 27001 certification, a SOC 2 Type 2 attestation, and GDPR compliance.

last_funding.notes: Funnel announced an $80 million debt facility in January 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The January 2026 debt financing occurred within the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job board lists an AI Product Engineer role and no SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or Account Executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: Funnel announced the Funnel MCP Server on 2026-05-19, within the six-month window; this is described as a product launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: I could not verify a comprehensive leadership/team roster or a dated announcement/profile that establishes a C-level or VP-level join or departure during the period.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These CRM or sales/marketing systems are named on Funnel’s public connections/integrations page.
